ca.story.1.text: In a cozy little house on Monster Island, Bobbo was fast asleep.

ca.story.2.text: When the sun peeked out, Bobbo woke up. Rumble, rumble, went his tummy!

ca.story.3.text: Breakfast time! But oh no, the wind blew his snacks all over the meadow!

ca.story.4.text: Hoo-hoo! Let's help Bobbo find his snacks, and count them carefully, one by one!

ca.story.mid1.text: Bobbo's basket is getting fuller! His tummy is still rumbling.

ca.story.mid2.text: Halfway there! Bobbo can smell the cookies!

ca.story.mid3.text: Just a few more, and it's breakfast time!

ca.story.end1.text: Yum! Thanks to you, Bobbo has all his breakfast snacks!

ca.story.end2.text: Hoo-hoo! Counting carefully helped us find every single one.

ca.story.end3.text: You brought back a Brain Spark! Next time, Bobbo will need even more snacks!

ca.help.explain.text: Hoo-hoo! Here's a trick. Touch each snack once, and say one number for each. The last number tells how many!

ca.help.hint.text: Hoo! Let's slow down. Touch each one, one at a time, and listen for the last number.
